note: Pricing-rule registry for every key path that appears under message.usage in Claude Code transcripts. scripts/check_usage_fields_priced.py fails CI when a transcript (or the committed fixture) carries a key path that is not listed here, so a new billable field can never be silently ignored. rule is one of: priced (tracegauge.cost prices it), free (the page says no charge), ignored (not an additional charge; reason says why), unmodelled (billable or possibly billable, NOT priced; tracegauge says so in the cost note). Key paths use [] for list elements. value_guards lists the only values of a field the registry knows how to price (or has judged benign); any other value (e.g. speed=turbo, a new inference_geo, a non-standard service_tier) fails the gate because it may change the bill and tracegauge.cost would price it as standard. Evidence for each entry: docs/PRICING_FIELDS.md.

usage.output_tokens.reason: output rate x tokens; includes thinking tokens

usage.cache_read_input_tokens.reason: input rate x per-model read multiplier (0.1x default; 0.05x Opus/Sonnet 5.5; 0.025x Fable/Mythos 5.1)

usage.server_tool_use.web_search_request.reason: $10 per 1,000 searches added to the turn's cost (prices.json server_tool_rates), on top of tokens; errored searches are not billed by the API but cannot be seen in a transcript, so every recorded search is charged

usage.server_tool_use.web_fetch_requests.reason: page: no additional charge beyond token costs

usage.server_tool_use.code_execution_req.reason: billed by container execution time (not in the transcript); free with web search/fetch 20260209+; detected and warned about

usage.service_tier.reason: value 'standard' on every record seen; the page has no priority-tier price, so any other value fails the gate via value_guards

usage.speed.reason: 'fast' uses the model's fast_input/output_usd_per_mtok (Opus 5.5 $8/$40; Opus 5 and 4.8 $10/$50) with cache and geo multipliers stacked on top; a model without fast rates is priced standard and the session note says so; 'standard' and null are standard

usage.inference_geo.reason: 'us' is 1.1x on every token category of Claude 4.6 and later models (prices.json geo_us_multiplier); an earlier model is priced standard and the session note says so; 'global', 'not_available' and null are 1.0

usage.iterations.reason: list of the sampling iterations whose sum equals the top-level usage (32,691/32,691 records checked); pricing the top level already covers it, pricing both would double count

usage.output_tokens_details.thinking_tok.reason: subset of output_tokens (thinking <= output on 32,692/32,692 records checked); already billed as output

usage.fallback_credit.reason: null on every record seen (0 non-null); not on the pricing page; a non-null value cannot be priced from here
